title: Your Case File, Evidence and Representation in Appeals and Grievances
content:
Each **Appeals and Grievances** case type gives the member a copy of the case file and evidence, a right to present evidence and testimony, and rules on who may file for the member. The terms differ by case type as set out below.

| Case type | Case file and evidence free of charge | Case file sent within (calendar days after the request) | Evidence and testimony in person or in writing | New evidence accepted until | Signed authorized representative form when someone else files | Provider may file with the member's written consent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member Grievance | Yes | 7 | Yes | Resolution | Required | Yes |
| Quality of Care Grievance | Yes | 7 | Yes | Resolution | Required | Yes |
| Standard Appeal | Yes | 7 | Yes | Resolution | Required | Yes |
| Expedited Appeal | Yes | 1 | Yes | Resolution | Required | Yes |
| State Fair Hearing | Yes | 7 | Yes | The hearing date | Required | Yes |
| External Medical Review | Yes | 7 | Yes | The review decision | Required | No |

## The same terms stated as rights

- **Case file.** On every case type the member may have the case file and evidence free of charge. It is sent within 1 calendar day of the request on an Expedited Appeal and within 7 calendar days of the request on every other case type.
- **Evidence and testimony.** On every case type the member may present evidence and testimony in person or in writing. The latest point new evidence is accepted is the resolution on a Member Grievance, a Quality of Care Grievance, a Standard Appeal and an Expedited Appeal; the hearing date on a State Fair Hearing; and the review decision on an External Medical Review.
- **Filing for the member.** On every case type a signed authorized representative form is needed when someone other than the member files. A provider may file on the member's behalf with the member's written consent on every case type except External Medical Review, where a provider may not file for the member.
